issue_text: matchesExclude() treats a non-'/**' exclude as an EXACT path match ('return file == exclude'), but git's ':(exclude)<dir>' pathspec matches that directory recursively. matchesExclude is used only by matchesAnyExclude inside exactExcludesExcept (the exceptions path), which converts each changed file that matches an exclude into an exact ':(exclude)<file>' pathspec. So for a bare-directory exclude like ['build'] combined with any exception, matchesExclude('build/foo.js','build') is false, build/foo.js is never added to effectiveExcludes, and it leaks into the reviewed Diff/ChangedFiles/DiffStat. Without the exception, the same exclude goes straight through withPathspec as ':(exclude)build' and git excludes build/ recursively (verified: git diff --name-only -- . ':(exclude)build' drops build/foo.js). Net effect: adding a single unrelated --except path silently un-excludes an entire bare-named directory.

DiffStat, StagedStat and WorkingTreeStat (lines 174-176) build their pathspec from the ORIGINAL 'excludes', while the Diff, --name-only file lists and byte measurements (lines 121-136) all use 'effectiveExcludes'. The two are identical unless exceptions are present; under CollectWithExcludesExcept, effectiveExcludes is the exact file list that KEEPS the excepted target, but the *Stat lines re-apply the raw 'docs/metareview/**' glob which drops the target. Result: the excepted target file appears in Diff and ChangedFiles but is missing from DiffStat, so the summary stat disagrees with the diff it summarizes.

The main collect() path enumerates files with 'diff --name-only' / 'ls-files --others' WITHOUT -z (lines 133-136, 156, 195-198, 254-257), so with git's default core.quotePath=true a non-ASCII path comes back C-quoted (e.g. "\303\274.txt" with surrounding quotes). splitLines keeps the quoted literal. For untracked files this reaches safeJoin/os.Stat with the literal quoted name, os.Stat fails, and the file is silently dropped from UntrackedExcerpts AND from totalBytes (readUntrackedExcerpts line 523-524) — under-inclusion with no omitted/truncated counter incremented. The same quoted literals also break exact comparison against exceptions/excludes. The branchfiles.go path deliberately uses -z (--name-only -z, split on NUL) and is tested against exotic/unicode names, showing the authors handle this in one path but not the other.

matchesExclude line 238 guards 'if exclude == "." || exclude == ""', but line 237 has just run exclude = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(exclude)), and filepath.Clean never returns "" (it returns "." for empty input). So the 'exclude == ""' disjunct is unreachable. The same dead disjunct appears at line 205 in exactExcludesExcept ('file == ""' after file = filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Clean(file)) on line 204).
